one_line: An elite patron from the Karkota court overseeing multi-sect temple and monastery projects at Parihasapura in 8th‑century Kashmir.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, lean but dignified build, upright posture
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, light brown Kashmiri complexion, straight nose, neatly groomed short beard and moustache, calm thoughtful eyes with slightly sharp brows, default expression a composed half‑smile showing political poise and quiet devotion
appearance.hair: thick dark brown hair, parted slightly off‑center and combed back to neck length, bound by a narrow gold headband with a tiny central lotus motif, no turban or crown
appearance.costume: a knee‑length Kashmiri wool tunic (kurta‑like) in deep saffron‑orange with long fitted sleeves and subtle woven floral motifs at cuffs, worn over ankle‑length straight trousers in muted cream; a rich pashmina‑style shawl in dark indigo draped from the left shoulder across the torso and around the back, with a thin border of repeating stylised rosettes in gold; a narrow maroon cloth belt at the waist with a small bronze buckle; simple soft leather shoes in dark brown; minimal jewellery: a single gold ring on the right hand and a thin gold chain around the neck bearing a small pendant that is double‑sided, one face showing a tiny engraved trident and the other a tiny seated Buddha outline, never fully legible but clearly dual‑symbolic
appearance.signature: a rolled palm‑leaf manuscript bundle tied with a red cord held in his left hand, edges of the leaves visible, symbolising temple grants and monastery charters, with a small bronze seal case hanging from the cord

ref_desc: Parihasapura Patron is a lean, bearded Kashmiri man with dark brown hair and gold headband, in saffron tunic, cream trousers, indigo shawl, maroon belt, gold pendant, holding a red‑tied palm‑leaf manuscript bundle, using saffron, indigo, cream, maroon and gold colors.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of the Parihasapura Patron: an early‑30s Kashmiri man with an oval, light brown face, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm sharp eyes and a composed half‑smile. His thick dark brown hair is neck‑length, parted off‑center and combed back, held in place by a narrow gold headband with a tiny central lotus motif. He wears a knee‑length deep saffron‑orange wool tunic with long fitted sleeves and subtle woven floral motifs at the cuffs, over ankle‑length straight cream trousers. A rich dark indigo shawl is draped from his left shoulder diagonally across his torso and around his back, its edge marked by a thin border of repeating gold rosettes. A narrow maroon cloth belt with a small bronze buckle sits at his waist, and he has simple dark brown soft leather shoes. For jewellery, give him a thin gold neck chain with a small double‑sided pendant hinting at a trident on one side and a seated Buddha outline on the other, and a single gold ring on his right hand. In his left hand he firmly holds his signature prop: a rolled palm‑leaf manuscript bundle tied with a red cord, a tiny bronze seal case hanging from the cord, symbolising temple and monastery grants. Use a harmonious palette dominated by deep saffron orange, dark indigo blue, cream, maroon and gold, and show him standing in a neutral pose front‑facing with clear views of face, hair, costume and the manuscript bundle.
